verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official, documented CLI. It installs via `npm i -g vercel`, and the docs say it works "through an automated system" for logs, DNS, certificates and local environment replication. It also has agent-specific commands: `vercel agent init` writes AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guidance and `vercel skills` discovers agent skills. Agent onboarding playbooks list the CLI as a supported surface. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's use in AI-agent workflows (all evidence is first-party docs, the GitHub repo, or a probe).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system, enabling you to retrieve logs, manage certificates, replicate your deployment environment locally, manage Domain Name System (DNS) records, and more.

npm i -g vercel
vercel login
vercel
